subject: Quick on-demand demo request and a few fit questions
messages:
From: Simon Patel <simon@oncall.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in a short on-demand demo after self-serve trial

Hi Laura,

We just spun up a short self-serve trial of Redwood last week (thanks for the docs — very smooth). I was the one who created the account (Simon Patel, Head of ML at OnCall AI). After poking around the hosted API and demoing a couple flows, my PM asked if we could get a quick on-demand demo to walk through: integration patterns for online inference, recommended batching for bursty chat traffic, and options for an isolated Dedicated environment.

We have a small sandbox dataset we can share and would like to understand typical pilot timelines and what level of telemetry / SLAs you offer out of the box. Hoping for a 20‑30 minute session.

Available generally next week (Mon/Tue mornings PT). If there's a short intake form you prefer I can fill that first.

Thanks,
Simon
Simon Patel
Head of Machine Learning, OnCall AI
mailto:simon@oncall.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Simon Patel <simon@oncall.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in a short on-demand demo after self-serve trial

Hi Simon — thanks for signing up and for the note. Laura is our Solutions lead and can run a short session to cover integration and pilot planning. Quick Qs so Laura can tailor the call: 

- Primary use case: (chat assistant / retrieval-augmented generation / embeddings + search / other)
- Volume profile: average concurrent users and expected peak requests/day (ballpark is fine)
- Latency needs: 50ms / 100-200ms / best-effort?
- Pilot timeline: planning to start pilot in weeks / 1–2 months / 3+ months?
- Any data sensitivity (PII/PHI) or on‑prem/VPC requirement for the pilot?

If you prefer, drop answers in reply and we’ll suggest 3 slots (20–30m). Laura — I left Monday morning PT as Simon's preferred window.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
SDR, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Simon Patel <simon@oncall.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in a short on-demand demo after self-serve trial

Hi Simon — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for trying the self-serve path. I can run a focused 25-minute session to cover: quick integration patterns, batching recommendations for bursty chat, pilot sizing, and high-level Dedicated vs. Hosted tradeoffs.

Before we lock a time, two quick clarifying items so I prepare examples that match your workload: 

1) Use case (one line): e.g., "multi-turn customer support assistant with browsing and RAG" or "realtime search embedding for recommendations".
2) Expected weekly traffic during pilot (requests/day or messages/day). If you only have concurrent users, a ballpark is fine.
3) Typical prompt length / avg tokens per request (short chat prompts ~50 tokens, long generation >300 tokens).
4) Deadline for pilot decision or production goal (e.g., "pilot in 2–4 weeks, production after Q4").
5) Any compliance constraints (we support Dedicated/VPC; note any SOC2 / encryption / retention asks).

I attached a one-pager that summarizes our deployment options and a short pilot checklist we use with new customers — should speed the conversation.

Proposed 25-min slots (PT):
- Thu 2027-07-22 10:00–10:25
- Fri 2027-07-23 09:00–09:25
- Mon 2027-07-26 08:30–08:55

Or send 2 times that work for you and we’ll adapt. If you want to give any of the qualification bullets above now (copy/paste answers), that’s fine too and will let me bring relevant benchmark numbers.

Attachments:
- redwood-onepager.pdf (product/hosting summary)
- pilot-checklist.xlsx (pilot milestones and typical lead times)

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference — production-first inference runtime

From: Simon Patel <simon@oncall.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in a short on-demand demo after self-serve trial

Thanks Laura — answers inline below. Happy to take the Thursday slot if it’s still open.

> 1) Use case
We’re focused on chat assistant for enterprise ops teams (ticket triage + automated runbook suggestions) that uses a small RAG index for internal docs.

> 2) Expected weekly traffic during pilot
Pilot will be small: ~3–5 concurrent users, ~1k–2k requests/day during testing, with spikes up to ~4k/day. Production target would be ~50k/day over a quarter.

> 3) Typical prompt length
Average payload is light: ~60–120 tokens, but a subset of sessions may trigger longer outputs (~300 tokens).

> 4) Deadline for pilot decision
We’d like to run pilot asap and decide within 3–4 weeks. Production goal around Q4.

> 5) Compliance constraints
We handle internal ops data, some messages include customer email addresses but not PHI. We’d expect to use Hosted initially and evaluate Dedicated/VPC if retention or audit controls are needed. SOC2 is a plus.

Please book Thu 2027-07-22 10:00 PT and send a calendar invite. If helpful, I’ll also drop a short example dataset link prior to the call.

—Simon
Simon Patel
Head of Machine Learning, OnCall AI
